name: paulmillr/noble-post-quantum
description: An auditable, minimal JavaScript/TypeScript implementation of post-quantum cryptography including ML-KEM, ML-DSA, Falcon, and SLH-DSA. Zero dependencies with PGP-signed commits for auditability.
score_rationale: Well-regarded JavaScript PQC library with 288 stars, providing rare browser-compatible post-quantum implementations with an emphasis on auditability and minimal attack surface.
